description: Set (or reschedule) a reminder on a saved item, by its id (ids come from search/fetch). Example: {itemId: '...', remindAt: '2026-07-10T09:00:00Z', deliveryMethod: 'email'}. One reminder per item - calling again reschedules it. Delivery: email (default), whatsapp or telegram. whatsapp and telegram are not available on every account; an unavailable choice returns an error.

itemId.description: The saved item to remind about (from search/fetch)

remindAt.description: When to remind - ISO datetime, e.g. 2026-07-10T09:00:00Z

name: create_reminder
title: Create a reminder
